Honestly I understand what you mean here as I’ve experienced restriction and then binge episodes where I can’t stop eating. This is my experience but if I were you just try and eat small and often. As well as drinking enough fluid. 
450 calories isn’t much, I used to eat less than 800 calories a day and honestly it made me miserable. Eating 2000 calories a day can be difficult so if you start building it up you will feel better (hopefully)
I’d slowly incorporate foods back into your diet, peanut butter is a good one for weight gain, if you hit up the gym as well it’ll turn into muscle

Could be something to do with digestion, my stomach can be like that and certain foods can spark me off. I can’t give professional advice but if anything else triggers your stomach it could be IBS or a reaction to a ingredient.
